about: Engine 2's worksheet map (docs/taxes.md "The tax engines"): how Tax-Calculator's outputs relate, written from its calcfunctions.py (scripts/taxcalc_map_skeleton.py prints each output's inputs). A formula names outputs (read back by taxcalc_run.py), record inputs and law parameters (dollars, for the year and filing status, or by the record field in param_index); `x * 0.5` is a rate, as is `x * NAME` for a parameter param_types calls a rate, `int(65)` a count, `usd(1000)` dollars in a product, `if_(condition, then, else)` a branch, `muldiv`, `steps_floor`, `steps_ceil` and `schedule` as taxcalc.compile_formula says, and a name under `parts` stands for its formula. Formulas cover current law: terms inert under it (a haircut of 0, a cap of 9e99, a reform-only switch) are left out. Each run checks every formula against the engine's own value: one that doesn't reproduce it (a law change that activates such a term) is shown as the engine's value only, and the conformance test fails. Reviewed against the pinned release and law file below: a different one isn't used.

parts.seniors: if_(age_head >= int(65), int(1), int(0)) + if_(MARS == int(2) and age_spouse >= int(65), int(1), int(0))
parts.salt_cap: if_(posagi > ID_AllTaxes_c_ps, max(max0(ID_AllTaxes_c - (posagi - ID_AllTaxes_c_ps) * ID_AllTaxes_c_po_rate), ID_AllTaxes_c_po_floor), ID_AllTaxes_c)
parts.pre_qbid_taxinc: max0(c00100 - max(c04470, standard) - c04600 - (senior_deduction + overtime_income_deduction + tip_income_deduction + auto_loan_interest_deduction))
parts.qbid_full_cap: max(PT_binc_w2_wages * PT_qbid_w2_wages_rt, PT_binc_w2_wages * PT_qbid_alt_w2_wages_rt + PT_ubia_property * PT_qbid_alt_property_rt)
parts.qbid_limited: if_(pre_qbid_taxinc <= PT_qbid_taxinc_thd, qbid_before_limits, if_(PT_SSTB_income == int(1) and pre_qbid_taxinc >= qbid_upper, 0, if_(pre_qbid_taxinc >= qbid_upper, min(qbid_full_cap, qbid_before_limits), if_(PT_SSTB_income == int(0), qbid_before_limits - muldiv(max0(qbid_before_limits - qbid_full_cap), pre_qbid_taxinc - PT_qbid_taxinc_thd, PT_qbid_taxinc_gap), qbid_sstb_qbi - muldiv(max0(qbid_sstb_qbi - qbid_sstb_cap), pre_qbid_taxinc - PT_qbid_taxinc_thd, PT_qbid_taxinc_gap)))))
parts.setax_p: min(net_se_p, SS_Earnings_c - min(SS_Earnings_c, e00200p + pencon_p)) * 0.124 + net_se_p * 0.029
parts.setax_s: min(net_se_s, SS_Earnings_c - min(SS_Earnings_c, e00200s + pencon_s)) * 0.124 + net_se_s * 0.029
parts.amt_exemption_phased: if_(MARS == int(3) and c62100 > AMT_em_pe, 0, max0(AMT_em - max0(c62100 - AMT_em_ps) * AMT_prt))
parts.amt_exemption: if_(age_head != int(0) and age_head < AMT_child_em_c_age and age_spouse < AMT_child_em_c_age, min(amt_exemption_phased, earned + AMT_child_em), amt_exemption_phased)
parts.amt_line38: amt_line17 * AMT_rt1 + max0(amt_line17 - AMT_brk1) * AMT_rt2_addon + amt_line23 * AMT_CG_rt1 + amt_line30 * AMT_CG_rt2 + amt_line33 * AMT_CG_rt3 + if_(e24515 == 0, 0, max0(amt_line6 - amt_line17 - (amt_line23 + amt_line30) - amt_line33) * AMT_CG_rt1250)
parts.amt_line7: if_(dwks10 > 0 or dwks13 > 0 or dwks14 > 0 or dwks18 > 0 or e24515 > 0, min(amt_flat, amt_line38), amt_flat)
parts.cdcc_expenses: max0(min(c32800, earned_p, if_(MARS == int(2), earned_s, earned_p)))
parts.cdcc_rate: if_(c00100 > CDCC_ps1, if_(c00100 > CDCC_ps2, max(CDCC_po2_rate_min, CDCC_po1_rate_min - steps_ceil(c00100 - CDCC_ps2, CDCC_po2_step_size) * CDCC_po_rate_per_step), max(CDCC_po1_rate_min, CDCC_po1_rate_max - steps_ceil(c00100 - CDCC_ps1, CDCC_po1_step_size) * CDCC_po_rate_per_step)), CDCC_po1_rate_max)
parts.aotc_share: min(int(1000), muldiv(max0(usd(90000) * filers - c00100), int(1000), usd(10000) * filers))
parts.llc_share: min(int(1000), muldiv(max0(if_(MARS == int(2), ETC_pe_Married, ETC_pe_Single) * int(1000) - c00100), int(1000), if_(MARS == int(2), 20000, 10000)))
parts.schr_base: if_(MARS == int(2), if_(age_head >= int(65) and age_spouse >= int(65), 7500, 5000), if_(MARS == int(3), 3750, 5000))
parts.schr_tentative: if_(age_head >= int(65) or (MARS == int(2) and age_spouse >= int(65)), min(max0(schr_base - (max0(e02400 - c02500) + max0(e01500 - e01700) + max0(c00100 - schr_threshold) * 0.5)) * 0.15, max0(c05800 - e07300 - c07180)), 0)
parts.ctc_phased: if_(ctc_tentative + odc_tentative > 0 and c00100 > CTC_ps, max0(ctc_tentative + odc_tentative - usd(1000) * steps_ceil(c00100 - CTC_ps, 1000) * CTC_prt), ctc_tentative + odc_tentative)
parts.eitc_phased: if_(earned > eitc_phaseout_start or c00100 > eitc_phaseout_start, min(eitc_most, max0(EITC_c - max0(max(earned, c00100) - eitc_phaseout_start) * EITC_prt)), eitc_most)
parts.eitc_age_ok: age_head == int(0) or (age_head >= EITC_MinEligAge and age_head <= EITC_MaxEligAge) or (MARS == int(2) and (age_spouse == int(0) or (age_spouse >= EITC_MinEligAge and age_spouse <= EITC_MaxEligAge)))

ymod1.label: Income before adjustments
ymod1.cite: Form 1040 lines 1-8 and Schedule 1 Part I

ymod.label: Income for the Social Security worksheet

c02500.label: Taxable Social Security benefits
c02500.formula: if_(ymod < SS_thd1, 0, if_(ymod < SS_thd2, min(ymod - SS_thd1, e02400) * 0.5, min((ymod - SS_thd2) * 0.85 + min(e02400, SS_thd2 - SS_thd1) * 0.5, e02400 * 0.85)))

setax.label: Self-employment tax
setax.formula: min(net_se_p, SS_Earnings_c - min(SS_Earnings_c, e00200p + pencon_p)) * 0.124 + net_se_p * 0.029 + min(net_se_s, SS_Earnings_c - min(SS_Earnings_c, e00200s + pencon_s)) * 0.124 + net_se_s * 0.029

standard.label: Standard deduction, with the charitable deduction for non-itemizers
standard.formula: if_(c04470 > 0, 0, STD + STD_Aged * (if_(age_head >= int(65), int(1), int(0)) + if_(MARS == int(2) and age_spouse >= int(65), int(1), int(0))) + min(e19800, STD_charity_ded_nonitemizers_max))
standard.note: Tax-Calculator keeps only the deduction taken: the standard deduction is 0 when it itemizes, and itemized deductions are 0 when it doesn't.

senior_deduction.label: Senior deduction
senior_deduction.formula: if_(MARS == int(3), 0, max0(SeniorDed_c - max0(c00100 - SeniorDed_ps) * SeniorDed_prt) * seniors)
senior_deduction.note: Each person 65 or older gets the amount, less 6% of AGI over the limit (AGI stands for modified AGI: foreign income isn't modeled).

tip_income_deduction.label: Qualified tips deduction
tip_income_deduction.formula: if_(MARS == int(3), 0, max0(min(tip_income, TipIncomeDed_c) - TipIncomeDed_po_step_size * steps_floor(max0(c00100 - TipIncomeDed_ps), TipIncomeDed_po_step_size) * TipIncomeDed_po_rate_per_step))

overtime_income_deduction.label: Qualified overtime deduction
overtime_income_deduction.formula: if_(MARS == int(3), 0, max0(min(overtime_income, OvertimeIncomeDed_c) - OvertimeIncomeDed_po_step_size * steps_floor(max0(c00100 - OvertimeIncomeDed_ps), OvertimeIncomeDed_po_step_size) * OvertimeIncomeDed_po_rate_per_step))

auto_loan_interest_deduction.label: Car-loan interest deduction
auto_loan_interest_deduction.formula: max0(min(auto_loan_interest, AutoLoanInterestDed_c) - AutoLoanInterestDed_po_step_size * steps_ceil(max0(c00100 - AutoLoanInterestDed_ps), AutoLoanInterestDed_po_step_size) * AutoLoanInterestDed_po_rate_per_step)
auto_loan_interest_deduction.note: Its steps round up (Schedule 1-A line 28), where the tips and overtime steps round down.

c04600.label: Personal exemptions
c04600.note: The exemption amount is zero from 2018 (§151(d)(5)); its phase-out and the under-18 switch are reform-only.

c17000.label: Medical and dental expenses (itemized)
c17000.note: Tax-Calculator keeps the itemized parts only when it itemizes.

c18300.label: State and local taxes (itemized, after the cap)
c18300.note: The cap falls by 30% of AGI over the limit, not below its floor.

c19700.label: Gifts to charity (itemized)
c19700.formula: if_(standard > 0 or e19800 + e20100 == 0, 0, min(min(posagi * ID_Charity_crt_noncash, muldiv(charity_left, e20100, e19800 + e20100)) + charity_left - muldiv(charity_left, e20100, e19800 + e20100), posagi * ID_Charity_crt_all))
c19700.note: The floor (0.5% of AGI from 2026) comes off the gifts once; what's left is split between cash and property as given, property up to 30% of AGI, and the total up to 60%.

c20500.label: Casualty and theft losses (itemized)
c20500.note: Personal casualty losses aren't sent (Tax-Calculator's haircut on them is 100% under current law).

c21040.label: Overall limit on itemized deductions
c21040.formula: if_(c21060 > c17000 + c20500 and c00100 > ID_ps, min((c21060 - c17000 - c20500) * ID_crt, max0(posagi - ID_ps) * ID_prt), 0)
c21040.note: The pre-2018 limit; its threshold is out of reach under current law.

c04470.label: Itemized deductions, after limits
c04470.formula: max0(itemized_net - min(itemized_net, max0(max0(c00100 - c04600) - II_brk6)) * ID_reduction_rate)
c04470.note: From 2026 itemized deductions are reduced by 2/37 of the smaller of them and the income above the 37% bracket. The engine itemizes when that gives less tax than the standard deduction.

qbided.label: Qualified business income deduction
qbided.formula: if_(qbinc >= PT_qbid_min_qbi and qbid_capped < PT_qbid_min_ded, PT_qbid_min_ded, qbid_capped)
qbided.note: 20% of business income less the deductible half of SE tax and SE health insurance; above the income threshold limited by W-2 wages and property (not sent: none), and never more than 20% of taxable income less net capital gain. From 2026 at least $400 with $1,000 of business income.

c04800.label: Taxable income
c04800.formula: max0(max0(c00100 - max(c04470, standard) - c04600 - (senior_deduction + overtime_income_deduction + tip_income_deduction + auto_loan_interest_deduction)) - qbided)

c23650.label: Net capital gain or loss before the loss limit

earned.label: Earned income
earned.note: Wages and self-employment income, less the deductible half of SE tax.

c05200.label: Tax on taxable income from the rate schedule
c05200.cite: 26 U.S.C. § 1; Tax Rate Schedules X, Y-1, Z

dwks10.label: Qualified dividends and capital gain for the worksheet
dwks10.cite: Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet line 4 / Schedule D Tax Worksheet line 10

dwks13.label: Gains taxed at the capital gains rates

dwks14.label: Taxable income less the gains
dwks14.cite: Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet line 5

dwks18.label: Income taxed at the ordinary rates
dwks18.formula: if_(has_pref, max(min(dwks14, min(CG_brk1, c04800)), max0(c04800 - dwks10)), 0)

dwks43.label: Tax with the capital gains rates
dwks43.formula: if_(has_pref, schedule(dwks18) + dwks28 * CG_rt2 + dwks31 * CG_rt3 + dwks37 * 0.25 + dwks40 * 0.28, 0)
dwks43.note: Ordinary income at the rate schedule, gains in the 15% and 20% bands, unrecaptured §1250 gain at 25% and collectibles at 28% (the 0% band adds nothing).

taxbc.label: Tax on taxable income
taxbc.note: With qualified dividends or long-term gains, the smaller of the worksheet's tax and the rate schedule's; otherwise the rate schedule's. The reform-only AGI surtax isn't included.

c62100.label: Alternative minimum taxable income
c62100.formula: if_(standard == 0, c00100 - e00700 - qbided - sch1a_amt - c04470 + c18300 + c20800 - c21040 + max0(min(c17000, c00100 * AMT_Medical_frt)), c00100 - e00700 - qbided - sch1a_amt) + cmbtp
c62100.note: Itemizers add back state and local taxes; a non-itemizer's standard deduction is added back whole. The senior deduction stays allowed.

c09600.label: Alternative minimum tax
c09600.formula: max0(amt_line7 - if_(f6251 == int(1), e62900, e07300) - max0(taxbc - e07300))
c09600.note: The tentative minimum tax (26%, then 28% above the bracket; gains at their own rates) less the regular tax.

c05800.label: Tax with the alternative minimum tax

c07300.label: Foreign tax credit, limited to the tax
c07300.note: Nonrefundable credits come off the tax in Schedule 3's order, each up to the tax still left.

c07180.label: Child and dependent care credit, limited to the tax
c07180.note: Expenses up to the lower earner's income, at 50% falling a point per $2,000 of AGI to 35%, then to 20% above the second threshold (the rate is in hundredths of a percent).

c87668.label: American opportunity credit, nonrefundable part
c87668.note: The tentative credit, phased out over $10,000 ($20,000 joint) of AGI above $80,000 ($160,000) as a share rounded to thousandths; 40% of it is refundable.

c07230.label: Education credits, limited to the tax
c07230.formula: min(min(llc_tentative, education_limit) + min(c87668, max0(education_limit - min(llc_tentative, education_limit))), tax_left - c07300 - c07180)
c07230.note: The lifetime learning credit (20% of up to $10,000, phased out like the AOTC) and the AOTC's nonrefundable part, up to the tax left after the foreign tax, care and elderly credits.

c07240.label: Retirement savings contributions credit, limited to the tax

codtc_limited.label: Child and other-dependent credit not used against the tax

c07220.label: Child tax credit, limited to the tax
c07220.formula: min(if_(ctc_phased > 0, muldiv(ctc_used, ctc_tentative, ctc_tentative + odc_tentative), 0), left_after_education - c07240)
c07220.note: $2,200 per child under 17 and $500 per other dependent, less 5% of each $1,000 (or part) of AGI over the threshold, up to the tax left; the child part is its share of what's used.

odc.label: Credit for other dependents, limited to the tax
odc.formula: min(if_(ctc_phased > 0, max0(ctc_used - muldiv(ctc_used, ctc_tentative, ctc_tentative + odc_tentative)), 0), left_after_education - c07240 - c07220)

c07260.label: Residential clean energy credit, limited to the tax

c07400.label: General business credit, limited to the tax

c07600.label: Prior-year minimum tax credit, limited to the tax

c07200.label: Credit for the elderly or disabled, limited to the tax
c07200.note: 15% of the base amount less nontaxable Social Security and pensions and half of AGI over the threshold (age 65 or older; disability isn't modeled).

c08000.label: Other nonrefundable credits, limited to the tax

ptax_amc.label: Additional Medicare tax
ptax_amc.formula: max0(wages_medicare - AMEDT_ec) * 0.009 + max0(net_se_p + net_se_s - max0(AMEDT_ec - wages_medicare)) * 0.009

ptax_was.label: Social Security and Medicare on wages (both halves)
ptax_was.formula: min(SS_Earnings_c, e00200p + pencon_p) * 0.124 + (e00200p + pencon_p) * 0.029 + min(SS_Earnings_c, e00200s + pencon_s) * 0.124 + (e00200s + pencon_s) * 0.029

c59660.label: Earned income credit
c59660.formula: if_(eitc_investment > EITC_InvestIncome_c or (EIC == int(0) and not eitc_age_ok), 0, eitc_phased)
c59660.note: The credit for the number of qualifying children (up to 3): earned income at the phase-in rate up to the maximum, then reduced by the phase-out rate on the larger of earned income and AGI above the threshold (higher for a joint return). With no children, one of you must be 25 to 64. None with investment income over the limit.

c11070.label: Additional child tax credit
c11070.formula: if_(codtc_limited > 0 and actc_most > 0, if_(n24 < ACTC_ChildNum, if_(actc_earned > 0, min(actc_line17, actc_earned), 0), if_(actc_earned >= actc_line17, actc_line17, min(actc_line17, max(actc_earned, max0(ptax_was * 0.5 + c03260 + e09800 - (c59660 + e11200)))))), 0)
c11070.note: The child credit the tax didn't use, up to $1,700 a child: 15% of earned income over $2,500, or with three or more children the larger of that and Social Security and Medicare paid less the EIC.

CDCC_refund.label: Refundable child and dependent care credit
CDCC_refund.note: Refundable for 2021 only; the credit is nonrefundable now (c07180).

refund.label: Refundable credits
refund.formula: eitc + c11070 + c10960 + recovery_rebate_credit + CDCC_refund + personal_refundable_credit + ctc_new

facts.e00900s: Your spouse's business profit or loss
facts.e09900: 10% on early distributions and 20% on HSA money not spent on medical care
facts.MARS: Filing status (1 single, 2 married filing jointly, 4 head of household)
facts.e18400: State and local income or sales tax
facts.e20100: Gifts to charity other than cash
facts.e03300: SEP and other self-employed retirement contributions
facts.PT_binc_w2_wages: W-2 wages paid by the business
facts.PT_SSTB_income: A specified service business (1 yes, 0 no)
facts.e87521: American opportunity credit, before the phase-out
facts.EIC: Qualifying children for the earned income credit (up to 3)
facts.e09800: Social Security and Medicare tax on unreported tips
facts.e02000: Rents, royalties, partnerships and S corporations (Schedule E)
